features.name: Adjust Density
features.desc: As an action, you double or halve the weight and Speed of a creature or object within 30 feet for 1 minute (hostile targets get a saving throw).

features.name: Gravity Well
features.desc: When you hit a creature with a spell, you can move it 5 feet into an unoccupied space.

features.name: Violent Attraction
features.desc: As a Reaction when a creature within 60 feet hits with an attack, you add dice to the damage (+d10 or more).

features.name: Event Horizon
features.desc: A 30-foot aura slows enemies and deals Force damage to those that enter it or start their turn there.
